headline: Anthropic soars in Nasdaq debut; UN court finds Myanmar genocide; Xi hails turnaround with Australia

austin.headline: Austin approves $25 million Lady Bird Lake boardwalk
austin.summary: The City Council approved a roughly 760-foot south-shore boardwalk funded by TxDOT, which had told the city to accept the money or lose it; the Austin Public Facilities Corporation will design and build it.

texas.headline: Paxton deal keeps border razor wire for 30 years
texas.summary: A settlement with federal immigration agencies lets Texas keep concertina wire in the Del Rio Sector and bars federal agents from cutting it except in emergencies, binding future state leaders including Gov.-elect Hinojosa.

texas.headline: Outgoing comptroller moves to narrow the data tax
texas.summary: Don Huffines proposed a rule shrinking which data processing services are taxable, which his office projects will cost $18 billion in sales tax over six years, despite the comptroller-elect asking him to halt new rules.

texas.headline: GOP's 2025 congressional map backfired
texas.summary: Designed to gain five seats, the Republican map instead produced a net loss of one as Democrats won about 53% of the statewide House vote and 14 of 38 seats.

texas.headline: Texas leads the nation in local 287(g) agreements
texas.summary: An investigation found 429 Texas agencies partner with ICE, with some collecting large federal payments, including nearly $2.2 million to the Smith County Sheriff's Office since January 2025.

texas.headline: Texas carries out its ninth execution of the year
texas.summary: Reinaldo Dennes, 70, was executed in Huntsville for a Houston jeweler's killing; his spiritual adviser said staff struggled repeatedly to find a vein, which prison officials disputed.

texas.headline: Tarrant County Republicans feud after a sweep
texas.summary: After losing all 17 contested countywide races, local GOP factions are trading public letters over who is to blame.

us.headline: Army to detonate 5 tons of unstable explosives in Iowa
us.summary: The Army planned Friday's disposal blast at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant under an emergency EPA permit, and some nearby Middletown residents were advised to leave or stay indoors as schools closed.

us.headline: Senate passes permitting reform bill
us.summary: The Senate approved a key permitting overhaul and sent it to the House.

us.headline: Congress nears shutdown deadline with no funding plan
us.summary: Lawmakers are approaching the government funding deadline without an agreed strategy to keep agencies open.

us.headline: Incoming House majority leader Clark stresses unity
us.summary: Rep. Katherine Clark, set to serve under Hakeem Jeffries, emphasized Democratic unity ahead of the new majority.

australia.headline: Xi hails 'complete turnaround' with Australia
australia.summary: Xi Jinping declared relations fully repaired as Albanese met him on the APEC sidelines in Shenzhen, with business leaders pressing for better market access for exports such as beef.

australia.headline: Albanese urges Putin directly to end the Ukraine war
australia.summary: Speaking at APEC, the prime minister called on the Russian president in person to stop the war.

australia.headline: US sanctions the Comanchero bikie gang
australia.summary: The US Treasury sanctioned the gang, four senior members and an associate over links to Latin American cartels, the first such action against an Australia-based crime group.

australia.headline: Ministers play down recession fears after jobs jump
australia.summary: Workplace Minister Amanda Rishworth said neither the RBA nor Treasury forecasts a recession, as pressure grows for spending restraint in the December budget update.

australia.headline: One in three Australian residents is a migrant, OECD says
australia.summary: New OECD data puts Australia's immigrant share far above the 12% OECD average, while permanent intake dipped 2% in 2025.

ai.headline: Anthropic shares jump in Nasdaq debut
ai.summary: ANT opened about 34% above its $83 IPO price and briefly topped $2 trillion in value, even as the broader market fell.

ai.headline: US approved nearly 900,000 AI chips for China, report says
ai.summary: The Trump administration reportedly cleared shipments of close to 900,000 AI chips to China.

ai.headline: Data center fight stalls Senate energy bill votes
ai.summary: A dispute over a proposed data center ban held up amendment votes on the permitting and energy bill.

ai.headline: Becerra floats prosecutions for AI-driven cyberattacks
ai.summary: Xavier Becerra suggested criminal prosecution for those behind AI-enabled attacks.

tech.headline: Bending Spoons to buy Mailchimp from Intuit
tech.summary: The Italian company agreed to pay €3.32 billion for the email marketing service, far below the roughly $12 billion Intuit paid in 2021; the deal needs regulatory approval.

tech.headline: National cyber director out; acting replacement named
tech.summary: The White House let go of national cyber director Sean Cairncross and named an acting successor.

world.headline: UN court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
world.summary: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority.

world.headline: Ukraine allies meet US envoys in Berlin
world.summary: Zelenskyy and the Coalition of the Willing met Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff on security guarantees as the China summit ended without a Ukraine breakthrough.

world.headline: Trump leaves China without meeting Kim Jong-un
world.summary: The summit declaration skipped the Korean Peninsula and Taiwan, raising concern in Seoul, Tokyo and Taipei about being sidelined.

world.headline: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 hub jobs as Iran war bites
world.summary: The airline plans the cuts in Frankfurt and Munich after its core carrier lost about €20 million a month this year, according to a staff letter.

world.headline: EU oil security plan to factor in military fuel
world.summary: A draft Commission overhaul would require governments to account for armed forces' diesel and jet fuel needs in emergency stocks, with a proposal due Dec. 2.

aus-cricket.headline: Players' union condemns media pursuit over Sandpapergate
aus-cricket.summary: ACA chief Paul Marsh called the treatment of players linked to the 2018 scandal disgraceful and said he still lacks details of Cricket Australia's proposed forum.

aus-cricket.headline: Smith to play Shield as Green misses after helmet blow
aus-cricket.summary: Steve Smith is set to turn out for NSW against Queensland on Sunday, while Cameron Green is not expected to play after being struck in the Hobart ODI.

warriors.headline: Grizzlies rout Warriors 126-98 to finish 0-5 trip
warriors.summary: Memphis never trailed as Charles Bassey led Golden State with 16 points and 13 rebounds, extending the losing streak to five.

warriors.headline: Warriors host Celtics on Sunday
warriors.summary: Golden State returns home to face Boston on Nov. 22; Stephen Curry (torn oblique) and Draymond Green (elbow) both sat out in Memphis.
